text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Inference path 5xx spike detected in az1a. 5xx rate > 10% (5m window). Paging oncall.
Kai: ACK — I'm on it, reaching for console now.
Nina: grabbing traces and customer impact.
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0423-az1a-eni-jitter. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/incidents/eni-jitter
Raman: seeing ENI attach/detach flapping on a subset of g5 hosts in az1a. kernel tx queue backlog and netdev tx drops in host logs.
Kai: rolling quick drains on a few impacted pods to force rebalance and clear local queueing.
Taylor: what's customer impact? any external 500s or long-tail timeouts?
Nina: customer-facing 500s ~12% across hosted-api inference routes; p95 latency jumped 120ms -> ~600ms. Some model-load timeouts seen.
Kai: running (one-off): ```kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=az1a -o name | xargs -n1 -I{} kubectl drain {} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```
Taylor: ok please add routing policy to throttle/shift critical routes away from az1a while we stabilize.
Raman: applying control-plane weights now: previous az1a=0.7 az1b=0.2 eu-west1=0.1 -> new az1a=0.35 az1b=0.4 eu-west1=0.25 (gradual over 2m).
Kai: also enabling model fallback for latency-sensitive customers to quantized variant redwood/gptx-2-q8 to reduce model-load CPU/GPU memory pressure.
oncall-bot: Pager update: oncall response active. Handoff scheduled to ops-sre in 30m.
Nina: started temporary autoscale in eu-west1: request +8 g5 ephemeral nodes (autoscaler triggered). ETA ~4m.
Kai: drain finished on 3 pods. After drain: immediate drop in tx drops on those hosts.
Raman: net counters snapshot from host-0123 before/after drain: ```# before: tx_queue_drops: 842; tx_failed_skb: 120
# after: tx_queue_drops: 14; tx_failed_skb: 2```
Taylor: customer-ops — please notify top enterprise accounts; DM draft at https://comms.redwood.internal/drafts/az1a-impact (short note + mitigation steps).
customer-ops: pinged Customer A and Customer B (top-tier). Both reported retries and latency but no data loss; they requested ETA and asked for follow-up postmortem.
Kai: metrics: 5xx down 12% -> 3% after routing/scale/fallback. p95 down to ~230ms. Continuing to monitor.
Nina: keep the route weights in place for another 10m, then reassess. Also add kernel tx scheduler tuning to post-incident action items.
Raman: filing INF ticket INF-2246 with detailed host captures and recommended AMI tweaks: increase txq_len, tune NAPI/irq affinity and NIC coalescing.
oncall-bot: Incident status -> mitigated, monitoring. Next oncall handoff to ops-sre in 28m. :white_check_mark:
Kai: small note — we'll keep the quantized fallback active for latency customers for the next few hours until we confirm stable egress behavior.
Nina: agreed. adding follow-up items to runbook and scheduling postmortem for tomorrow.
Taylor: thanks team. notify #customers-facing if any change.
customer-ops: acknowledged — will post updates and follow-up comms after postmortem.
